package records
namespace fieldupdates
entity Text id "fieldupdates://text"
entity Boolean id "fieldupdates://boolean"
entity Candidate id "fieldupdates://candidate" fields {
    field title id "fieldupdates://candidate/title" type string required one
    field state id "fieldupdates://candidate/state" type string required one
    field reason id "fieldupdates://candidate/reason" type string required one
}
activity Select(Candidate, Boolean) -> Candidate computes `let copy = input0
let saved = copy
if input1 && copy.state != "ready" {
    copy.title = saved.title
    copy.state = saved.state
    copy.reason = "deferred"
}
return copy` assembling {
    choice "title" field_update at "0" alternative "input0.title" intent "원래 제목을 사용한다. Keep the original title."
    choice "state" field_update at "1" alternative "\"ready\"" intent "선택된 기록의 상태는 ready이다. Set state to ready."
    choice "reason" field_update at "2" alternative "copy.title + \":\" + copy.state" intent "현재 제목과 갱신된 상태를 합친다. Join the current title and updated state."
    value_case "[{\"title\":\"한글\",\"state\":\"queued\",\"reason\":\"검토\"},true]" -> "{\"title\":\"한글\",\"state\":\"ready\",\"reason\":\"한글:ready\"}"
    value_case "[{\"title\":\"English\",\"state\":\"queued\",\"reason\":\"review\"},true]" -> "{\"title\":\"English\",\"state\":\"ready\",\"reason\":\"English:ready\"}"
    value_case "[{\"title\":\"\",\"state\":\"queued\",\"reason\":\"\"},true]" -> "{\"title\":\"\",\"state\":\"ready\",\"reason\":\":ready\"}"
    value_case "[{\"title\":\"kept\",\"state\":\"queued\",\"reason\":\"later\"},false]" -> "{\"title\":\"kept\",\"state\":\"queued\",\"reason\":\"later\"}"
    value_case "[{\"title\":\"already\",\"state\":\"ready\",\"reason\":\"done\"},true]" -> "{\"title\":\"already\",\"state\":\"ready\",\"reason\":\"done\"}"
    attempts "2"
}
activity Label(Candidate) -> Text computes `return input.title + ":" + input.state + ":" + input.reason`
bind Select.result -> Label.input
